title: The Grade a Returned Item Came Back At, Added to the Share Relieved on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Fee
content:
The grade the item came back at is then added. Where an inspection stands on the return and the grade last recorded is that the item came back new and sealed, the sealed grade share is added. Where an inspection stands on the return and the grade last recorded is that it came back opened with everything in the box, the complete grade share is added. In any other case nothing is added.

The sealed grade share is 15 per cent. The complete grade share is 8 per cent.

## What is read

Two things about the Northbeam Returns and Restocking return are read: whether any inspection stands recorded on it, and the grade the last of those inspections recorded. What is added is added to the share relieved against the fee still standing.

| Inspections standing on the return | Grade last recorded | Share added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| at least one | the item came back new and sealed | 15 per cent |
| at least one | the item came back opened with everything in the box | 8 per cent |
| at least one | any other grade | nothing |
| none | — | nothing |

Both conditions are compound: an inspection must stand on the return and the grade last recorded must be one of the two named, so a return with no inspection recorded on it adds nothing whatever else is known about the item.

## Cases on hypothetical inputs

*A return carrying one inspection which recorded that the item came back new and sealed.* Fifteen per cent is added.

*A return carrying three inspections, the last of which recorded that the item came back opened with everything in the box.* The grade last recorded is that third one, so 8 per cent is added.

*A return carrying two inspections, the later of which recorded that something was missing from the box.* The grade last recorded is in neither named row, so nothing is added.

*A return with no inspection recorded on it at all.* Nothing is added.
